scope: Source organization of completed recovery units; no new game algorithm recovery or whole-game acceptance.

checks.note: Targeted allowances preserve observed numerical and argument contracts; no algorithm changes.

hlsl_validation.inherited: Readable full_ok and original gate/SAME or original-empty status; unchanged recovered HLSL logic.
hlsl_validation.include_support: Only include closure used by accepted entry files; not independent helper acceptance.

limitations: Only recovered units of rhapsody/country-core/roof/tg-text are packaged; no complete game executable.
Original algorithms with resolved inputs or dependency classifiers retain those API boundaries.
Whole original module behavior, rendering frames, GPU/runtime/consumer integration and A/C adaptation are not accepted here.
